title: Northgate+ Membership Fee Refund Policy
content:
Refund policy for fees charged on Northgate Rewards and Northgate+ Memberships.

**1. Object of a refund.** A fee refund always refers to one settled fee charge, identified by its membership ledger reference, and is credited to the payment method that fee was charged to. Each fee charge is refunded at most once: a fee charge that already carries a refund is not refunded again. On an immediate cancellation of an annual-billed tier the refund is evaluated against the most recent settled fee charge on the membership.

**2. Full-refund window — time gate.** A full refund applies only when the immediate cancellation date is no later than the fee charge date plus the tier's annual full refund window days. Calendar days are added to the fee charge date, the day after the charge being day 1, and a cancellation on the last day of the window still qualifies.

| Hypothetical case (30-day window, fee charged on 10 March 2031) | Cancellation date | Inside the window |
|---|---|---|
| last day of the window | 9 April 2031 | yes |
| the day after | 10 April 2031 | no |

**3. Retired measure.** The following clause is **no longer in force**: *"The full refund also requires the benefit uses since the charge to be zero, and its refund basis is a full refund within the window. Otherwise, where a prorated refund on cancellation applies, the refund is the fee multiplied by the unused full months divided by the term in months, rounded down to the cent, with the basis of prorated unused months, and no refund is made when that count is zero."* It is superseded by the current basis: the immediate cancellation of a Northgate+ Annual membership whose most recent settled annual fee was charged to an external card is worked out under the annual cancellation schedule, and the immediate cancellation of a Northgate+ Business membership whose most recent settled annual fee was charged to an external card under the Business closure schedule. Every immediate cancellation that neither schedule handles keeps the base measure: a cancellation inside the full refund window with no benefit use since the charge refunds the whole fee with the basis of a full refund within the window, and otherwise, where a prorated refund on cancellation applies, the refund is the fee multiplied by the unused whole months divided by the term in months, rounded down to the cent, with the basis of prorated unused months, and nothing is refunded when that count is zero. Under that base measure, the benefit uses since the charge are the benefit uses recorded on the same membership dated from the fee charge date through the cancellation date, inclusive; the unused whole months are the largest whole number of calendar months that, added to the cancellation date (falling back to the last day of a shorter month), still reach a date on or before the renewal date.

**4. Monthly and free tiers.** Monthly-billed tiers and the free tier receive no refund on cancellation; their paid benefits run to the end of the billing period instead.

**5. Billing errors.** Independently of tier and timing, a billing error is refunded in full with the basis of a billing error: a second settled fee carrying the same billing period start as an earlier one, or a fee whose billing period starts on or after the date a confirmed cancellation took effect.

**6. Cap.** The clause *"A refund never exceeds the fee it refers to, and benefits already used are never billed back"* is **no longer in force** as a single rule. For a cancellation the annual cancellation schedule or the Business closure schedule handles, the refund never exceeds the fee it refers to, and what that schedule takes from the refund for Northgate Cash or for benefits already received is taken only out of that refund, so nothing is ever billed to the member beyond it; for every cancellation that neither schedule handles, a refund never exceeds the fee it refers to, and benefits already used are never billed back.

**7. Tier settings.** The benefit-use condition applies where the tier's full refund requires no benefit use, proration follows the tier's proration basis and refund rounding, and billing errors are refunded under the tier's billing-error refund setting.

superseded_clauses: The full refund also requires membership_msr_benefit_uses_since_charge to be zero, and its refund basis is full_within_window. Otherwise, where prorated_refund_on_cancel is true, the refund is fee x membership_msr_unused_full_months / term_months rounded down to the cent, with basis prorated_unused_months, and no refund is made when that count is zero.
A refund never exceeds the fee it refers to, and benefits already used are never billed back.
